limitations: Counts are snapshot GIS feature counts, not businesses, facade counts, current occupancy or visual acceptance.
Boundary-clipped sites retain their entire identity but only the in-scope portion is authorized; outside portions remain context.
Parcel/footprint phase routing uses greatest overlap; exact frontage packets override it. Face enumeration outside the first nine packets remains future per-corridor work.
Municipal centerlines do not establish current public access. Dated waterfront/utility/site evidence is required before rendering roads as drivable.
2022 shoreline imagery is a planning edge, not proof of 2026 flood-work conditions.
Only coincident mapped endpoints are joined. Grade-separated crossings are not assumed to connect.
The initial project-time estimate remains provisional until actual detailed storefront pilot sessions are timed.
